item.title: Version 1.0.30
item.description:
feat: "Precious time you've regained" stat

A new live-ticking stat appears on Home in both states:

  • Idle: shows total time you've reclaimed across every flip
    session, ever.
  • Flipped: same total — plus the current session's elapsed time
    rolled in, ticking up every minute while you sit flipped.

Format auto-scales: "47m", then "1h 47m", then "1d 4h 32m" once
you cross 24 hours.  Silver chrome to match the FLIPPED wordmark.

Nothing else on Home moves.
